title: Best of three rounds
hints: You don't have to compare everything at once. Keep a variable called `best` that holds the highest score you've seen so far.
Start with `int best = a;`. Then look at `b`: if it's higher than `best`, replace `best` with it. Do the same for `c`.
`int best = a; if (b > best) { best = b; } if (c > best) { best = c; } return best;`
